title: docs(adr): ADR-0146 amended in place — an upgrade plan may report a .custom override that hides a vendor change, as advice only
body:
Fixes #30881
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：只改 ADR-0146 的文字（就地修订，状态行加一条 2026-11-06 的「Amended in place」）：允许基础包的升级预览（upgrade plan）给出一条**提示**，列出「这个 `.custom` 覆盖挡住了本次升级对同名项的修改」，以及 `basedOn` 与已安装版本不一致的覆盖。
- **为什么改**：执行你在 cloud#3652 上对 D2 的裁决「修订为允许只提示（推荐）」；原文写死了「不产出升级差异、`basedOn` 不被读取」，挡住了后续的漂移提示卡（#30886）。
- **风险与回滚**：零运行时风险，没有代码、spec 或文档站改动；`basedOn` 仍然「只记录、永不拦截」，不拒绝安装、不自动合并、不自动 rebase。回滚 = revert 这一个提交。
- **先看**：`docs/adr/0146-…md` 的 D2 段（`basedOn` 那一句，风险最高：它定义了提示的两种情形 a/b）；其次 D6 的「Not done」一条和 Consequences 第三条。
- **两分钟验证**：`git diff origin/main -- docs/adr/0146-*` 应只见 7 处文字改动 + 1 条 Refs；`pnpm check:adr-index` 应打印 `docs/adr/README.md is current`。
- **需要你做的**：审阅后亲手合并（Tier H，草稿状态，席位不会转 ready、不入队、不开 auto-merge）。

## What changes

ADR-0146 is amended in place for decision D2 on epic objectstack-ai/cloud#3652 (ruling record [`6681380041`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/cloud/issues/3652#issuecomment-6681380041), maintainer, verbatim: 「修订为允许只提示（推荐）」). A base's upgrade plan may list, as advisory findings, (a) a `.custom` item whose declared override names a base item the upgrade changes, and (b) an override whose `basedOn` is not the installed base's `manifest.version`. `basedOn` stays recorded and never gates: no refusal, no token, no automatic merge, rebase or rewrite. Whole-document replace, ADR-0141 D3's deferral and merge question 1's `^MAJOR` reasoning are unchanged.

The diff touches only `docs/adr/0146-studio-designs-setup-administers-one-editor-per-item-paired-customize-package.md`. `pnpm adr:index` was regenerated and wrote a byte-identical `docs/adr/README.md` (the index shows a truncated status prefix, which this amendment does not reach), so the README is not in the diff.

### Before / after of each amended sentence

| Passage (line on `d55acb78`) | Before | After |
|:---|:---|:---|
| Status line (`:23`, appended) | (no 2026-11-06 note) | "· **Amended in place** (2026-11-06, decision D2 on epic objectstack-ai/cloud#3652, ruling record `6681380041`, maintainer, verbatim: 「修订为允许只提示（推荐）」): a base's upgrade plan may report, as advice, each `.custom` override that hides a vendor change; `basedOn` still never gates, and nothing is refused, merged or rebased on the finding (D2, D6, the Supersede table's §9 row, Consequences, merge question 2). It lands by the maintainer's hand-merge of the PR cut from #30881." |
| D2 (`:210-212`) | "**`basedOn` is recorded, not judged**: no door compares it with the installed base's version, no upgrade diff is produced, and nothing is refused on it (epic #28236, …recorded only)." | "**`basedOn` is recorded and never gates** (epic #28236, …recorded only). **One reader is admitted, as advice** (amended 2026-11-06, …): a base's **upgrade plan** … may list as advisory findings (a) a `.custom` item whose declared override names a base item the upgrade changes between the installed and the new version ("this override hides a vendor change"), and (b) an override whose `basedOn` is not the installed base's `manifest.version`. On either finding no door refuses, no token is asked, and nothing is merged, rebased or rewritten automatically; the upgrade proceeds as it would without it, and re-basing stays the customer's act. The plan carries both findings in an **advisory class** that its refusal never reads and that no finding-set token covers, so neither becomes a gate by sharing a response with a refusing finding. The finding is not the base-upgrade interception ADR-0141 D3 defers, because it refuses nothing, and D3's `^MAJOR` reasoning (merge question 1) is unchanged." |
| D2, §9 lift (`:262`) | "**Diff-vs-base and the upgrade skip-report stay deferred**" | "**The advisory upgrade finding above is chartered; a field-level diff-vs-base view and the upgrade skip-report as a merge tool stay deferred** (amended 2026-11-06)" |
| D6 "Not done" (`:393`) — not named by the card | "**No clone lineage, no upgrade diff, no `basedOn` judgement** (D2, D4)." | "**No clone lineage, no field-level upgrade diff, no gate on `basedOn`** (D2, D4) — the upgrade plan's advisory finding (D2, amended 2026-11-06) refuses, merges and rebases nothing." |
| Supersede table, ADR-0126 §7.4/§9 row, *Rule now* (`:563`) | "badge, customization list and revert are chartered on served facts, diff-vs-base and the skip-report stay deferred (D2)." | "badge, customization list and revert are chartered on served facts; the upgrade plan's advisory finding is chartered (amended 2026-11-06); a field-level diff-vs-base view and the skip-report as a merge tool stay deferred (D2)." |
| Consequences, third bullet (`:600-601`) | "…until the customer re-bases it, and the platform computes no diff to help (D6)." | "…until the customer re-bases it. The base's upgrade plan names each override that now hides a change, as advice (D2, amended 2026-11-06); re-basing stays the customer's act, and the platform computes no field-level diff and merges nothing (D6)." |
| Merge question 2 (`:679-681`) | "**`basedOn` is recorded and never judged** — … no card reads `basedOn` as a gate (D2)." | "**`basedOn` is recorded and never gates** — … no card reads `basedOn` as a gate (D2). One reader is admitted, as advice (amended 2026-11-06, …): the upgrade plan's finding of D2, which lists an override whose base item the upgrade changes or whose `basedOn` is not the installed base version, and refuses nothing." |
| Refs (appended) | — | a bullet naming card #30881, the ruling record, and the finding's own card #30886 on the upgrade plan of #30884. |

Unchanged on purpose: D3's dependency-range bullet ("where `basedOn` is read by a human") and merge question 1 (the `^MAJOR` reasoning), per the card's item 6; the Supersede row's *Gate and pin* column (the finding's code is card #30886's).

## Acceptance notes

- **D6's "Not done" bullet was amended although the card does not list it.** Left as written ("no upgrade diff, no `basedOn` judgement") it would contradict the amended D2 inside the same record; the change keeps it as narrow as the ruling (no gate, no field-level diff).
- **`scripts/adr-index.mjs` reads header fields from a record's first 40 lines only (`HEADER_WINDOW = 40`).** A status note that pushes `**Supersedes in part**` past line 40 makes the regenerated index silently empty that record's Supersedes cell, and `pnpm check:adr-index` still exits 0 because its `--report` never fails. This PR keeps the status note to 3 lines: ADR-0146's Supersedes line sits at `:38` and its index row is unchanged (zero `docs/adr/README.md` diff after `pnpm adr:index`). The producer fix is objectstack-ai/objectstack#30916, a separate non-governed card, not part of this Tier H PR.
- **Quotes of the old sentence elsewhere, listed and not edited:**
  - Governed: `docs/adr/0126-packaged-metadata-customization-model.md:3` (its status-line pointer: "diff-vs-base and the skip-report stay deferred"); `skills/objectstack-platform/evals/config-plugins-ops.json:169` ("`basedOn` recorded and never judged").
  - Not governed, and not the same sentence (they describe today's runtime, where nothing reads `basedOn` yet — editing them before #30886 lands would advertise an undelivered capability): `content/docs/api/metadata-api.mdx:105`, `content/docs/concepts/metadata-lifecycle.mdx:121`.
  - Generated / code (card #30886's surface): `packages/spec/src/kernel/override-declaration.zod.ts:98`, `:137`, `:141` and the `content/docs/references/**` pages generated from it; `packages/metadata-protocol/src/served-override.ts:35`, `protocol-packaged-base-refusal.ts:1016`.
- **Changeset:** none — `docs/adr/**` publishes nothing; `skip-changeset` is declared with this PR.
- **Tier H — the maintainer merges.** `docs/adr/**` is a governed surface (Prime Directive #14). This PR stays a draft; no seat readies it, requests review, queues it or arms auto-merge.
